verdict.rationale: Slack's own docs say AI in Slack takes huddle notes, with key takeaways, action items and who said what organized when the huddle ends. Slack also claims it can 'use AI to take meeting notes', which directly covers the core of the story. Daily recaps are documented only for channels and threads. Nothing shows that notes reach people who missed a huddle, or that notes cover meetings outside huddles. missing for 10: explicit evidence that huddle notes/recaps are delivered to users who missed the huddle, documentation of AI notes for non-huddle meetings (e.g., external calendar meetings), meeting-specific recaps (the documented recaps cover channels/threads), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can get AI-generated notes and recaps from meetings and huddles I attended or missed

citations.quote: AI in Slack keeps you focused on the conversation by taking notes for you. Key takeaways, action items, and who said what are all neatly organized when the huddle ends
even use AI to take meeting notes
AI in Slack can summarize channels and threads and serve up daily recaps
